method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Indian shares poised to rebound as Fed-hike fears, oil prices ease
Equities.reason: Regional equity rebound narrative tied to easing Fed-hike fears and lower oil — supportive for Indian equities and risk-on flows. Relevant to broader market regime and liquidity/yield transmission into equities.

Equities.title: Schneider Electric Expands in AI With $22.6 Billion PTC Purchase
Equities.reason: Large, strategic M&A explicitly tied to AI — reinforces the dominant market narrative of AI leadership driving deal flow, capex and sector rotation. Material market-moving corporate action with broad equity implications.

Equities.title: AI Deal Frenzy Powers Hong Kong Fundraising to Record Summer
Equities.reason: Fresh capital raising driven by AI deals in Hong Kong signals continued hot flows into equity markets and APAC listings — supportive for regional equity sentiment and the AI-led market regime.

Equities.title: Booming Leverage in Indian Stocks Fuels $33 Billion Debt Binge
Equities.reason: Material risk signal: surge in margin/leverage raises potential for sharp de-risking and volatility in Indian equities — a significant negative tail for the market and for regional risk appetite.

Equities.title: China Fund Closures Head for Eight-Year High as Demand Fades
Equities.reason: Large-scale fund closures and falling demand are a clear negative for China equity flows and sentiment — reinforces an outflows/liquidity constraint narrative for EM/China equities.

Equities.title: Bolsonaro’s First-Round Lead Sets Brazil Assets for Monday Surge
Equities.reason: Political shock in Brazil (Bolsonaro lead) is translating into immediate positive equity reaction expectations — a country-specific but market-moving risk-on impulse for Brazil assets.

Equities.title: Broadening Rally in Stocks Hits an Economic Roadblock
Equities.reason: Macro/economic headwinds curbing a broadening equity rally is a cross-market signal that could slow risk-on momentum — meaningful negative for market breadth and cycle-sensitive sectors.

Equities.title: Wall Street Strategists Steer Investors to Cross-Asset Hedges
Equities.reason: Advisory shift toward cross-asset hedging signals rising caution among strategists — modestly negative for risk appetite and suggests higher demand for downside protection in equities.

Equities.title: Corporate America has never been this upbeat about future profits
Equities.reason: Elevated corporate profit optimism supports the earnings-led bullish case for equities, but as a sentiment/forward-looking datapoint it carries moderate relevance versus macro/liquidity drivers.

Rates.title: As Treasury yields touch generational highs, investors brace for market fallout
Rates.reason: Headline signals a meaningful Treasury selloff and higher-for-longer yields — material negative for bond prices and central to the rates narrative.

Rates.title: Surging Treasury yields don’t signal a U.S. 'fiscal apocalypse' — yet
Rates.summary: Treasury yields above 5% are raising fears that higher borrowing costs could fuel a debt spiral.
Rates.reason: Confirms further upside in US yields (~>5%) and market concern over fiscal/financing stress — negative for bond valuations but notes limits to immediate systemic fallout.

Rates.title: Wall Street’s AI Party Is on Edge as Soaring Yields Raise Risks
Rates.reason: Links rapid rise in yields to broader market risk repricing (equities/tech), underscoring cross-market impact of higher rates and reinforcing a bond-negative regime.

Rates.title: Emerging-Market Carry Bulls Back Trade as US Yields Top 5%
Rates.reason: Confirms US yields breaching 5% and shows market adaptation (carry trades), but still reflects a high-yield environment that is negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Indian Bond Yield Curve Seen Flatter as RBI Drains Surplus Cash
Rates.reason: RBI liquidity drain implies upward pressure on short-term yields and a flatter curve — local rates tightening that contributes to the broader global rates tightening narrative.

Rates.title: French debt yields rise as fiscal worries mount
Rates.reason: Rising French yields on fiscal concerns point to renewed euro-area sovereign risk and add to the global bond-selloff backdrop — negative for European bond prices.

Rates.title: French Bonds at Risk of More Japanese Selling on Outsized Stake
Rates.reason: Highlights potential non-domestic selling pressure (Japanese sellers) that could exacerbate moves in French yields — an additional negative liquidity/flow risk for sovereign bonds.

Rates.title: Rebuked by Bond Market, Bessent Says ‘House’ Does Not Always Win
Rates.reason: Illustrates active market repricing and downside for bond managers amid the selloff — supportive evidence of stress in fixed-income markets.

Rates.title: Paramount’s $52 Billion Debt Sale Shows How Higher Rates Are Biting Corporate America
Rates.reason: Corporate issuance pain underscores broader higher-rate environment raising funding costs — negative for credit spreads and corporate bond demand.

Rates.title: US data week: ISM, labor and sentiment in focus – TD Securities
Rates.summary: Munoz and Nir expect a relatively quiet US data calendar, with ISM Services likely slipping to 54.0 versus 55.0 consensus, modestly higher Jobless Claims, and a small decline in UMich Sentiment to 47.5. They note September payrolls moderated mainly on seasonal
Rates.reason: TD Securities flags moderating payrolls and softer activity indicators which, if confirmed, would be modestly supportive to bonds (lower yields) — but lower relevance vs. the dominant surge narrative.

Rates.title: US economy: Mixed labour and inflation picture – NBC Economics and Strategy
Rates.summary: NBC Economics and Strategy highlights that U.S. nonfarm payrolls rose just 29K in September versus a 90K consensus, while the household survey showed a 406K employment surge and a 4.2% unemployment rate. Q2 real GDP was revised up to 2.2% annualized. The headl
Rates.reason: Mixed labour data (very weak payrolls in establishment survey) point to upside risk for slower Fed tightening or earlier easing expectations — a modest positive signal for bonds, but secondary to the prevailing high-yield narrative.

Rates.title: Liquidity Indicators in the JGB Markets (August)
Rates.reason: BOJ liquidity indicators are relevant given recent cross-border flows and reports of Japanese involvement in European bond selling; cautious negative score reflects potential JGB market strain but limited direct detail in the release.

Rates.title: Japan's Takaichi vows to carefully manage annual debt issuance
Rates.summary: Japanese Prime Minister Takaichi Sanae said on Monday that the government will control the annual debt issuance amount appropriately while scrutinising the economy, prices, tax revenues, interest rates, debt-servicing costs, and market developments.
Rates.reason: A government pledge to manage issuance can be mildly supportive for sovereign bond market technicals (reducing supply risk), but significance is limited relative to larger yield drivers.

FX.title: Australian Dollar weakens amid Middle East tensions, cool inflation
FX.summary: AUD/USD inches lower after registering modest gains in the previous day, trading around 0.6940 during European hours on Monday. The pair remains subdued as the US Dollar (USD) gains ground on rising safe-haven demand, driven primarily by deteriorating geopolit
FX.reason: USD safe-haven bid (geopolitical risk) driving AUD/USD lower; clear USD-strength FX transmission and material for AUD moves.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index gathers strength above 102.00 on safe-haven flows
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 102.20 in the early Asian trading hours on Monday. The DXY holds positive ground amid safe-haven flows.
FX.reason: Broad DXY strength is the dominant FX driver here — large-market impact, lifts USD against majors and reinforces a risk‑off USD bid.

FX.title: Breaking: Euro plummets to May 2025 low vs bullish USD amid France's debt crisis
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair comes under intense selling at the start of a new week, breaking below the 1.1200 mark and hitting its lowest level since May 2025 during the Asian session.
FX.reason: Major EUR/USD downdraft driven by France fiscal/political stress — a clear, high‑relevance USD strength theme with regional contagion risk.

FX.title: Euro slides to 17-month low against dollar
FX.summary: High energy prices and concerns over France’s public finances add to pressure on the single currency
FX.reason: Reputable macro coverage linking French fiscal/energy issues to EUR weakness vs USD; reinforces a broader euro‑negative, USD‑positive regime.

FX.title: Euro tumbles sharply, gap between France-German yields widen
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) underperforms its major currency peers at the start of the week, weighed down by increased fiscal risks in France amid surging costs on public finances and political instability.
FX.reason: EUR underperformance tied to French fiscal risk and widening core yield dispersion — directly relevant to EURUSD and cross‑rate pressures.

FX.title: Euro: Political risks weigh on common currency – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen argues that growing concerns over France’s public debt sustainability are now weighing on the Euro (EUR), after previously leaving the currency largely untouched despite bond market turmoil.
FX.reason: Sell-side macro analysis linking France debt worries to EUR weakness — supports the dominant USD‑strength / EUR‑weak narrative.

FX.title: Swiss Franc weakens as safe-haven demand lifts US Dollar
FX.summary: USD/CHF gains ground after two days of losses, trading around 0.8310 during Asian hours on Monday. The pair is currently appreciating due to a strengthening US Dollar (USD) amid rising safe-haven demand, which could be attributed to deteriorating geopolitical
FX.reason: USD safe‑haven bid lifting USD/CHF; notable because CHF is normally a safe haven — underscores USD leadership across majors.

FX.title: Japanese Yen steadies around 158.00 as PM Takaichi vows debt containment
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) nurses marginal losses against the US Dollar (USD) on Monday but remains trading within previous ranges, with downside attempts limited as Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi pledged to keep public debt under control.
FX.reason: JPY marginally weaker vs USD but political commitment to debt containment limits volatility — moderate USD‑strength signal with capped downside for JPY.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Drifts higher above 1.4250, remains bullish but overbought
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair gathers strength to around 1.4280 during the early European trading hours on Monday. Oil prices fall as rising crude exports from the Middle East and G7 nations' release of oil add to supplies, weighing on the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar
FX.reason: USD/CAD technical/price‑forecast piece with explicit commodity transmission (oil → CAD). Treated as lower‑relevance technical FX news per rules.

FX.title: British Pound: Rebound capped as downside bias lingers against US Dollar – UOB
FX.summary: United Overseas Bank (UOB) strategist Quek Ser Leang notes GBP/USD recovered to 1.3238 after failing to extend Thursday’s decline, but intraday gains are expected to stay within 1.3215–1.3265.
FX.reason: GBP/USD remains capped vs USD — market note consistent with a broader USD‑positive, GBP‑vulnerable backdrop; moderate relevance.

FX.title: CEE FX: Inflation supports koruna over peers – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Frantisek Taborsky expects higher September inflation across Czech Republic and Hungary, with Czech data seen backing a November rate hike. He forecasts unchanged policy in Poland and Romania, maintains a bearish regional FX bias, and favours the Czech k
FX.reason: Local CEE monetary/inflation story supporting the koruna vs regional peers — FX‑native but lower relevance to the USD‑centric major‑pair regime.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah weakens as elevated import cost weigh on balance of payments
FX.summary: USD/IDR gains ground after posting modest losses in the previous day, trading around 17,950 during the early European hours on Monday.
FX.reason: USD/IDR moving higher on local external‑balance pressures; relevant EMFX move tied into broader USD demand, modest relevance.

FX.title: Indian Rupee egdes up as hawkish Fed bets recede
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens marginally higher against the US Dollar (USD) after an extended weekend. Indian markets were closed on Friday due to Mahatma Gandhi Jayanti.
FX.reason: INR gains as Fed‑hawkish expectations ease — direct USD transmission but small absolute move, lower relevance.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar flirts with YTD low, below 0.5600 amid resurgent USD demand
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair kicks off the new week on a weaker note and slides back below the 0.5600 mark during the Asian session, close to its lowest level since November 2025 touched on Friday.
FX.reason: NZD weakness explicitly attributed to resurgent USD demand — clear USD‑led pressure on a commodity/FX proxy with moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Gold gains as October Fed rate hike prospects fade
Commodities.reason: Fed hike odds fading -> lower real yields and weaker USD typically support higher gold. This is a market-wide macro driver for precious metals, hence high relevance and a strongly positive direction.

Commodities.title: Gold holds gains above $4,150 as traders trim bets on Fed rate hikes
Commodities.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) gains momentum to near $4,160 during the early Asian trading hours on Monday. The precious metal rebounds as weaker-than-expected US Nonfarm Payrolls (NFP) data weigh on the US Dollar (USD).
Commodities.reason: Confirming piece that US data and retreating Fed tightening expectations are supporting gold; reinforces the precious-metals bullish narrative but is somewhat redundant with broader macro headlines, so medium relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD gains near $61.00 as Fed rate hike odds decline
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) gains ground after registering losses in the previous day, trading around $61.00 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Friday.
Commodities.reason: Silver is following the precious-metals bid from softer US policy expectations; positive but smaller magnitude than gold and slightly lower relevance as a single-commodity move.

Commodities.title: OPEC+ agrees to keep November oil output targets steady
Commodities.reason: OPEC+ holding output steady is a clear supply-side restraint that supports oil prices. This is a high-impact, market-wide fundamental driver for crude (Brent/WTI).

Commodities.title: Oil: Diverging supply signals shape Brent – ING
Commodities.summary: ING’s Warren Patterson notes that ICE Brent has repeatedly dipped below $100/bbl but continues to settle above this level as the market weighs conflicting supply and geopolitical factors. Higher oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz, G7 reserve releases, and
Commodities.reason: Market nuance: Brent trading around $100+ as supply risks and geopolitical flows offset releases. Overall leans supportive for oil but highlights mixed signals; medium relevance as it captures current price regime.

Commodities.title: Japan has no plans for new oil release from national reserves, official says
Commodities.reason: A refusal to add more SPR releases removes a potential source of incremental supply relief, which supports oil prices modestly; relevant but not a game-changer on its own.

Commodities.title: Saudis Cut Flagship Oil Price to Asia to Lowest in Six Years
Commodities.reason: Saudi OSP cut to Asia signals demand weakness/market-share actions that exert downward pressure on regional crude prices. This is a material counter-signal to supply restraint and thus negative for oil.

Commodities.title: Iraq Shifts Oil Strategy by Arranging Tanker to Move Past Hormuz
Commodities.reason: Logistical steps to route oil past the Strait of Hormuz reduce chokepoint vulnerability and lower geopolitical risk-premium, exerting modest negative pressure on oil prices.

Commodities.title: U.S. natural gas production reached a record high in July 2026
Commodities.summary: U.S. natural gas production hit an all-time high in July 2026, driven primarily by increased output in the Permian Basin, according to our latest Natural Gas Monthly.
Commodities.reason: Record US gas output increases supply and typically weighs on Henry Hub and related natural-gas contracts; a clear bearish fundamental for natural gas prices.

Commodities.title: Henry Hub natural gas prices this summer were 6% lower than last summer
Commodities.summary: The Henry Hub natural gas spot price averaged $2.93 per million British thermal units from June through August, 6% less than the same period last year. Prices were lower this summer despite exceptionally hot weather that increased electricity demand for air co
Commodities.reason: Lower summer Henry Hub prices confirm softer gas pricing pressure; aligns with higher production and weaker price momentum — negative for natural-gas bulls.

Crypto.title: Crypto traders are in risk-on mode as bitcoin dominance nears return to 60%
Crypto.reason: Rising BTC dominance signals capital rotating into Bitcoin and a risk-on crypto market regime — strong market-wide flow signal supporting higher BTC and broader crypto sentiment.

Crypto.title: Ether's bitcoin-beating Q3 rally came with a catch. Liquidity thinned.
Crypto.reason: Thinning liquidity raises downside risk and amplifies volatility for ETH despite rally — a meaningful intra-crypto risk signal with moderate market impact.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin is about to get a major bullish signal it hasn't had in over a year
Crypto.reason: A widely-followed technical/market signal turning bullish can draw momentum flows and leveraged positioning into BTC — positive for near-term price action and sentiment.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin open interest jumps $2.3 billion as traders pay more for bullish positions
Crypto.reason: Material rise in BTC derivatives open interest and bullish leverage points to stronger speculative positioning and potential for amplified moves — pro-risk for crypto markets.

Crypto.title: Tether's USDT is 'coming home' to Bitcoin after more than a decade
Crypto.reason: USDT moving to Bitcoin (onchain liquidity) can increase stablecoin-BTC native flows and trading liquidity for BTC — structurally positive for Bitcoin demand and settlement flows.

Crypto.title: Ethereum has a 25-day wait to start staking, with nearly 1.5 million ETH in line
Crypto.reason: Large queued staking amounts effectively lock up liquid ETH supply for weeks, supporting price via reduced available float — meaningful for ETH fundamentals.

Crypto.title: Once a $2 billion Ethereum layer-2, Blast is shutting down after assets plunge 98%
Crypto.reason: Major L2 collapse and near-total asset loss is a sharp negative for sector trust and risk appetite, raising counterparty and smart-contract risk across DeFi.

Crypto.title: BlackRock offers a glimpse of how tokenization may change your investment portfolio
Crypto.reason: BlackRock-led tokenization use-cases underscore institutional adoption and productization of crypto/blockchain — positive for long-term capital inflows and legitimation.

Crypto.title: BNY in talks with Kraken parent Payward over infrastructure partnership
Crypto.reason: Potential bank-crypto infrastructure tie-up signals greater institutional custody/operational support — positive but relatively narrow operational impact.

Crypto.title: Trump’s potential AI czar, Jay Clayton, helped pioneer the SEC’s crypto crackdown
Crypto.reason: Prominent regulator associated with enforcement suggests policy/regulatory headwinds remain a meaningful downside risk to crypto adoption and market structure.
